clue.text: Large partridge — lots seen around, but tons lost

indicators.note: seen turned around, the word is read from its far end back to its start
something lost is gone, so the word for tons drops out of the word before it

blocks.note: lots means a great many
taken as written
T is the abbreviation for tons

explanation.surface: Someone spots a big partridge with plenty of birds about, though the heavy ones have gone.
explanation.walkthrough: YNAMBU is the tinamou, a South American game bird; BUT without its T gives the closing BU.
explanation.definitionFit: The ynambu is a large South American tinamou, a bird popularly called a partridge.
